page.desks_lede: Desks connect employees to the person who answers.
page.desks_empty_body: A desk is a door to a responsible colleague. Create one when you know who answers what.

ticket_empty.title: {name} just opened this ticket.
ticket_empty.body: No messages yet. Reply to get started.

ticket_composer.locked: The ticket is resolved. Botsson closed the channel.
ticket_composer.trust_line: Private ticket · only {requester} and you see the messages · resolve when clarified

mobile_ticket_forbidden.title: This ticket isn't yours
mobile_ticket_forbidden.body: Ask your admin to assign it to you.

toast.skranke_upgraded: This channel is now a helpdesk.
toast.skranke_downgraded: Helpdesk turned off. The channel is back to regular chat.
toast.skranke_downgrade_blocked: The channel has {count} open tickets. Resolve or reassign them before turning off the helpdesk.

skranke_tab.title: Helpdesk
skranke_tab.lede: A helpdesk turns a channel into a door to a responsible colleague.
skranke_tab.section_heading: Turn this channel into a helpdesk
skranke_tab.section_lede: A helpdesk binds the channel to a responsible colleague. Employees ask — responsible answers and closes the case.
skranke_tab.responsible_sub: The person who answers cases at this helpdesk.
skranke_tab.autosave_hint: Changes save when you press Save.
skranke_tab.preset_aapen_summary: Regular channel — everyone can read and write as before.
skranke_tab.preset_offentlig_summary: Open helpdesk where everyone in the channel sees the questions.
skranke_tab.preset_offentlig_consequence_primary: Responsible answers. All members see the thread.
skranke_tab.preset_privat_summary: Each case gets its own private sub-thread between employee and responsible.
skranke_tab.preset_privat_consequence_primary: Messages are private — only responsible and the asker see them.
skranke_tab.preset_tilpasset_summary: Pick each setting yourself. Presets recommended.
skranke_tab.preview_private_body: The main channel shows only a "Start private case with HR" button. Each case opens a private sub-thread between employee and responsible. Other members see neither question nor answer.

channel_settings.title: Channel settings
channel_settings.general_lede: Rename, add a description, or manage the channel lifecycle.
channel_settings.general_description_placeholder: What is this channel for? (max 280 characters)
channel_settings.general_archive_consequence: Channel becomes read-only. History is preserved.
channel_settings.general_delete_consequence: Channel and all messages are permanently deleted.
channel_settings.general_delete_confirm_label: Type the channel name to confirm: {{name}}
channel_settings.members_load_error: Could not load members. Try again.
channel_settings.ai_lede: Control how Botsson participates in this channel.
channel_settings.ai_level_suggest_lede: Botsson reads the channel and suggests actions when relevant.
channel_settings.ai_level_suggest_consequence: Botsson may proactively suggest — no autonomous actions.
channel_settings.ai_level_agent_lede: Botsson can act autonomously (requires C4 authority).
channel_settings.ai_level_agent_consequence: Botsson can perform actions — subject to C4 authority gates.
channel_settings.ai_level_agent_warn_sensitive: This is a sensitive channel. Voice AI is restricted (ADR-0078). Override required.
channel_settings.ai_cap_reminders_sub: Botsson sends shift and task reminders.
channel_settings.ai_voice_warning_body: This channel is an HR private helpdesk. Voice AI with personal data is restricted. Only override if you have a documented basis.
channel_settings.ai_voice_override_label: I confirm — override voice restriction for this channel
channel_settings.retention_lede: Set how long messages are kept and when the channel auto-archives.
channel_settings.retention_preset_30d_consequence: Messages older than 30 days are deleted.
channel_settings.retention_preset_90d_consequence: Messages older than 90 days are deleted.
channel_settings.retention_preset_1yr_consequence: Messages older than 1 year are deleted.
channel_settings.retention_auto_archive_sub: Automatically archive the channel after N days without new messages.
channel_settings.retention_export_sub: Download all messages as JSON or Markdown.
channel_settings.retention_legal_hold_sub: Lock retention to permanent until a date. Admin only.
channel_settings.retention_hold_active_body: Retention is locked to permanent until {{date}}. Retention period cannot be changed.
channel_settings.retention_hold_locked: A legal hold is active. Lift the hold before changing retention.
